reviews.comment: Boring, it's so boring. You can barely hear him in the lecture hall unless you are in the front row. he has a thick accent and reads very monotone. the class is easy on top of that, you just needa memorize quizlets.

Don't do it, he's so quiet and has a thick accent. I took this class cause geology is my minor and I love geology, he almost made me change it. Never have I regretted taking a teacher this much in my life, the lectures are long and boring and he doesn't even try to keep the students engaged, he obviously loves geology but cmon man we can't hear you

One of the best professors I have had. Lectures are a bit bland but he goes into great detail. Attendance is about 10% and is taken randomly so just make sure to go to class. Quizzes are open-note and easy. 2 exams, which are closed notes, aren't that bad. Just make sure to review his notes and what he says in class is important. Labs are easy too

he is so fun! he is a bit monotone but that does not affect the class to be honest. just make sure to go and do your participation sign up and the quizzes (which are open note). the exams are literally the easiest and are simple, they are just general and its easy to get an A in this class. he is also good at explaining any questions you may have

The lectures are very boring, however, you will do great in this class if you pay attention to the content of the quizzes. The midterms are almost identical to the quizzes, and the final is basically quiz questions and midterm questions.

Lots of in class quizzes, so make sure you take notes and are prepared. Dr. Sun was very nice, but a little quiet at times. Labs are a large portion of the grade, but are a bit more difficult due to how qualitative geology can be at times. As long as you show up, an A is 100% doable, and you will learn a lot in the process.

He's a little dull and monotone, but hey - It's geology! He is very knowledgeable about the subject and willing to talk to you about any questions you have. There are weekly quizzes - if you go over the slides they are easy. Also open note!

Professor Yuefeng is a little bit quite but really loves what he does and cares about his students. This class also had a lab that is taught by a TA which was the hardest part about this class. the labe requires a good amount of time but the lectures taught by professor yuefeng arent bad. READ THE TEXTBOOK + DAILY QUIZZES = GOOD EXAM GRADE
Allowed open book quizzes and tests
